title: feat: add `@mermaid-js/parser` package and `info` langium parser
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary - Create the `parser` package inside `packages/parser`. - Create `info` langium parser and integrate it in `packages/mermaid`. - add `title`, `accTitle`, and `accDesrc` to `info` grammar. - ignore yaml, comments, and directives in `info` grammar ### Benchmark (Vitest) JISON commit: 99978da55b5a3c383272343c4c92bb1d42cc8cbf Langium commit: 6fa82944f58b0c512e0b29008dfb2d9ceb82e583 (langium has more possible hidden rules and attributes) | name | hz | min | max | mean | p75 | p99 | p995 | p999 | rme | samples | |------|----|-----|-----|------|-----|-----|------|------|-----|---------| | JISON | 476,910.58 | 0.0012 | 5.7337 | 0.0021 | 0.0028 | 0.0044 | 0.0058 | 0.0158 | ±0.64% | 1000000 | | Langium | 307,517.52 | 0.0025 | 0.7103 | 0.0033 | 0.0030 | 0.0069 | 0.0092 | 0.0194 | ±0.29% | 1000000 | ### BREAKING CHANGES - Remove `showInfo` from `infoDb`. ### Issues - Resolves #4 - Partially #4401 ## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions How langium parser works? ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor Package participant Module participant TokenBuilder participant Lexer participant Parser participant ValueConverter Package --> Module: Create services Note left of TokenBuilder: When to override? For keywords
and rules needs custom function Note left of TokenBuilder: When to reorder? When langium makes
rules at the begging because of performance TokenBuilder --> Module: Override or/and reorder rules (if needed) TokenBuilder --> Lexer: Read string and transform it to token stream Lexer --> Parser: Parse token stream into AST Note left of ValueConverter: For example: remove double
whitespace and double quotes Parser --> ValueConverter: Clean/modify tokenized
rules returned value (if needed) ValueConverter --> Package: Return AST ``` > From https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/pull/4727#issuecomment-1683825997 ### :clipboard: Tasks Make sure you - [x] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://github.com/mermaid-js/mermaid/blob/develop/CONTRIBUTING.md) - [x] :computer: have added necessary unit/e2e tests.

I think we should remove all these from `mermaid` package, and encapsulate all langium related logic inside the other package. 

```mermaid
flowchart TD
    JISON["Current"] --> Text["Text"] --> B(Loop through detectors)
    B --> C{Does it match?}
    C -->|No| B
    C -->|Yes| E("new Diagram()")
    E --> P(Parse)
    P --> DB(Update DB)
    DB --> R(Render)

    Langium --> Text2["Text"] --> Par("const {type, ast} = mermaid-parser.parse(text)")
    Par --> ND("new Diagram({type, ast})")
    ND --> PDB("populateDB(ast)")
    PDB --> R
```
comments.label_reasoning: Recommends moving langium-related logic out of the mermaid package and into the dedicated parser package.
